description: Flux de déchèterie is published by ADEME. The table records collection-centre material flows by year, service and waste category. Its stated coverage is France; service-level annual flows. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. These flows overlap with other SINOE aggregates and must not be double-counted. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
